description: Verify that T2 = 0.875 × lease — REBINDING REQUEST emitted within T2 ± ParamToleranceTime of the last DHCPACK (RFC 2131 §4.4.5)
approach:
[Objective]
T2 is when the client falls back to broadcast renewal after the original server has been unresponsive. RFC 2131 §4.4.5 sets it at 0.875 × lease. This case asserts the elapsed time between ACK and the REBINDING REQUEST is in [T2 - tol, T2 + tol].

[Scenario — chronological]
1. DORA → BOUND with lease = L.
2. T1 → RENEWING REQUEST.
3. Tester silent (no ACK).
4. Wait until t_ACK + 0.875 × L; DUT must emit REBINDING REQUEST around this point.

[Pass condition]
(t_rebinding - t_ACK) ∈ [0.875 L - tol, 0.875 L + tol].

[Fail condition]
Any chain step missing OR Fail_rebinding_request_t2_out_of_bounds — interval outside the tolerance window.

verdicts.Pass: REBINDING REQUEST at T2 ± tolerance — normal
verdicts.Fail_no_discover: No DUT DHCPDISCOVER within the listen window
verdicts.Fail_no_renewing_request: No DUT renewing DHCPREQUEST after ACK
verdicts.Fail_no_rebinding_request: No DUT rebinding DHCPREQUEST within listen window
verdicts.Fail_rebinding_request_t2_out_of_bounds: DUT rebinding REQUEST T2 interval out of bounds
